dict.string: FloorplanLab reads accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer samples to estimate your walking path (dead-reckoning) while you walk through a room. Motion data stays on this device.
FloorplanLab scans for nearby Bluetooth beacon signal strength (RSSI) to help correct its position estimate against known beacon locations. No pairing or data is written to any device.

FloorplanLab plays a brief chirp tone and records its echo to estimate wall distance using acoustic sonar, similar to how sonar or echolocation works. Audio is processed on-device only and is not stored or transmitted.

FloorplanLab best-effort reads basic info about the Wi-Fi network you are currently connected to as a weak positioning signal. iOS does not allow apps to perform a raw Wi-Fi signal scan; this is a best-effort read of already-connected network info only.

FloorplanLab best-effort reads which Wi-Fi network you are connected to (name/signal only, not a scan of nearby networks) as a weak positioning signal, which iOS only exposes under location permission.
